email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Assistant at Brussels Marriott Hotel
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Assistant role at Brussels Marriott Hotel, as advertised on Hosco. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am confident in my ability to support your online presence and marketing campaigns.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage website content, optimize pages for search, and create engaging blog posts. I have worked with WordPress, Shopify, and various analytics tools, and I am comfortable collaborating with designers and suppliers to produce marketing materials. My strong organizational skills and ability to multitask under pressure align well with the demands of this role.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to contribute to a prestigious hotel brand and to grow within a dynamic team. I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, which I am continuously improving.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Brussels Marriott Hotel.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Assistant position at Brussels Marriott Hotel, as listed on Hosco. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am eager to bring my skills to a renowned hospitality brand and support your online presence and marketing initiatives.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites. I manage CMS content, ensuring that pages and blog posts are up-to-date and optimized for search engines. I have also worked on Shopify stores, maintaining product catalogues and writing blog content. My freelance work includes building and optimizing websites for various clients, where I collaborate with designers and use tools like Canva to create marketing materials. This experience has honed my ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently under pressure.

I possess strong organizational and administrative skills, having managed invoices, contracts, and reporting in my freelance projects. I am proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint, and familiar with publishing tools and design best practices. I actively use social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn, both personally and professionally, and understand their role in engaging audiences. My writing skills are excellent, with a keen eye for spelling and grammar, and I have a technical background that allows me to quickly learn new computer programs.

I am a team player who thrives in collaborative environments and is highly professional in appearance and conduct. I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, which I am improving. I am drawn to the hospitality industry and am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the Sales & Marketing Director's day-to-day operations and to support creative campaigns.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Brussels Marriott Hotel.

Sincerely,

cv_highlights:
• CMS content management: publishing and updating pages, blog posts, and media in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) for client websites.
• SEO & analytics: on-page SEO, keyword research, and reporting using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
• Social media integration: designed websites with social media integration and familiar with platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
• Administrative skills: managed invoices, contracts, and reporting in freelance projects; proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
• Team collaboration: worked with designers and suppliers on marketing materials and campaigns, and supported team in building SharePoint sites for major clients.
